description: Injects the orchestra routing protocol (express vs orchestrated lane) at session start, re-injects it after /clear, resume, and compaction, appends a short per-prompt reminder so the router survives long sessions, and (opt-in, off by default) nudges a direct Claude Haiku subagent spawn toward `agent-exec dispatch` once per task when enforcement.light_class=block, with four independent escape hatches so it can never become a hard wall
